sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mani Yagyesh Tripathi,Premnendra Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

This third bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 248 of 2018,
under Sections 363, 366, 376, 507, 328, 374, 344, 323 Ipc and Section 3 / 4 of Pocso Act, police
station Ghoorpur, District Prayagraj, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim has not made any allegation of rape against applicant but in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has changed her version and made allegations against applicant as well as against one Prem Chandra.

sentences.text: 4. It is further submitted that the first bail application of the applicant-accused was rejected by this Court vide order dated 20.2.2020 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 7861 of 2019 and second bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 25.11.2020 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 27769 of 2020 and the trial Court was directed to make every endeavour to decide the case expeditiously preferably within a period of nine months but trial has not been concluded so far.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 27769 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 19.7.2018 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than five and a half years and that trial of the case would take sufficient long time.

The applicant has no criminal antecedent and that in case he is granted bail, he will not misuse liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.
5.
Learned A. G. A. has opposed the application and submitted that the first and second bail applications of the applicant have already been rejected.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations all attending facts and particularly period of detention, without expressing any opinion, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Chetanand Gupta involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
